input_rationale.evolution: First AstrAI integration; no upstream maintenance or release history exists yet.
input_rationale.locality: The runtime change is isolated to parallel planning, setup, and DDP device selection, with separate tools, tests, and documentation.
input_rationale.tests: The complete AstrAI suite passed: 631 passed and 103 environment-dependent tests skipped.
input_rationale.failure: Malformed, partial, asymmetric, and unknown topology inputs fail closed; invalid device permutations are rejected.
input_rationale.contract: Digest-bound planner, CLI, launch, and DDP mapping acceptance tests all passed.
input_rationale.integration: The planner is exported through astrai.parallel and consumed by the existing setup and executor paths.
input_rationale.interface: Environment variables and planner CLI output are documented and tested.
input_rationale.lifecycle: Logical LOCAL_RANK is preserved while LOCAL_DEVICE selects the mapped accelerator.
input_rationale.buildtest: The full test suite, Ruff formatting, and import-order checks passed.
input_rationale.policy: The candidate adds no dependency and leaves natural rank order as the safe fallback.
input_rationale.attainment: Measured selection chooses the best tested mapping for each request-concurrency shape.
input_rationale.coverage: The required 8x RTX 5060 Ti cell was tested; optional SM90 and SM100 cells were not.
input_rationale.retention: The planner retains natural order for DP4xSP2, avoiding the measured 9.67% topology-label regression.
input_rationale.family: DP1/2/4/8 shapes and MiniMax-H3 online-FP8 end-to-end inference were covered.
input_rationale.compile: The Python planner adds no timed compilation path.
input_rationale.replay: Collectives use seven trials with worst-rank median and p99 reporting.
input_rationale.load: Single-request MiniMax-H3 was exercised end to end; DP2/4/8 deployed multi-request service load was not.
input_rationale.resource: Peak GPU memory, retained headroom, all-GPU utilization, and clean service shutdown were checked.
input_rationale.coldsteady: Initialization, first valid request, warm request, and 10-step stability request were recorded.
